audience: facilities and maintenance teams that manage assets, inspections and schedules in Sitemate Gearbelt

useCases.title: Review the work orders of a workspace
useCases.text: List the work orders of the workspace. Then open one work order to read its details.

useCases.title: Check which schedule checks are due
useCases.text: List the schedule checks, which include due and completed maintenance checks. Then open one check by id.

useCases.title: Review issues and repairs
useCases.text: List the issues and the repairs in the workspace. Then open one issue by id.

useCases.title: Find the record behind a QR code
useCases.text: Resolve a scanned QR-code value to the record it marks. Then read the details of that asset.

useCases.title: Review the service history of an asset
useCases.text: List the completed schedule records, which form the service history. List the unit readings, such as meter values.
